proposal.reason: Primary change is in CE/DMA execution and OKI queue/ring ownership: reserving memcpy rings, hinting CE/user streams, and remapping OKI QP queue IDs to prevent CE/ltOki contention and mixed-operation hangs. Add symmetric because device-side symmetric OKI reduction logic is substantively corrected (tail chunk sizing, pre-broadcast clamping, and lane-slice alignment), which is independent kernel behavior beyond caller wiring.
